instructions_to_main_agent: You are building React components using .js/.jsx syntax located in /app/frontend/src.

Ensure every interactive element (button, link, input, tab, select, modal trigger) and metric text includes a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='medicine-search-input', data-testid='low-stock-count').
Maintain strict non-transparent backgrounds on all overlays, dropdowns, sticky headers, and popovers (e.g., bg-white shadow-lg border border-slate-200). Never rely on fully transparent surfaces.
Implement the strict role switcher on top header or login screen allowing seamless evaluation of Admin, Pharmacist, and Cashier views.
For billing/sale FIFO logic: automatically select stock from the batch with the nearest expiry date first and visually highlight the assigned batch ID with a FIFO badge.
Include high contrast colors for critical medical alerts: Red for <=30 day expiry alert, Amber for low stock alert, Green for in-stock and completed sale.
Integrate Sonner toasts (located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx) for feedback on invoice generation, medicine creation, stock batch updates, and error states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts or unstyled default tables. Use styled Shadcn tables with clean borders and hover highlights.
Do not use transparent background in headers, dropdowns, or modals.
Use specific CSS transitions (e.g. transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease). Avoid transition: all.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮) as system icons; use Lucide React icons instead.
Use 2-3x generous spacing inside cards (p-5 or p-6) to avoid cramped data presentation.
